_comment: Per-mic capture profiles. The recorder picks a profile by matching any string in 'match' against the device name (case-insensitive); first match wins. 'default' is used when nothing matches. Edit / extend at will — restart the voice loop to apply.

default.description: Cheap C-Media-class USB mics with a quiet idle floor.

profiles.name: razer
profiles.description: Razer Seiren / similar hot-preamp USB mics. Software-attenuated to keep peak RMS out of int16 clipping.

profiles.name: macbook
profiles.description: Apple MacBook built-in mic — soft preamp / built into laptop chassis far from speaker. Software-boosted ~2x so Moonshine has enough signal to lock onto.
